# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1 FROM golang:1.27-alpine AS builder LABEL org.opencontainers.image.source="https://example.invalid/repo" ARG VERSION=dev ENV CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux WORKDIR /src COPY go.mod go.sum ./ RUN go mod download COPY . . RUN set -eux; \ go build -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w -X main.version=${VERSION}" -o /out/app ./cmd/app; \ /out/app --version FROM alpine:3.21 RUN apk add --no-cache ca-certificates && \ adduser -D -u 10001 app USER app COPY --from=builder /out/app /usr/local/bin/app VOLUME ["/data"] EXPOSE 8080/tcp STOPSIGNAL SIGTERM HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s CMD ["app", "healthcheck"] SHELL ["/bin/sh", "-c"] ONBUILD COPY . /app ENTRYPOINT ["app"] CMD ["--serve"]
